meta.name: Blade Runner 2099
meta.description: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

videos.title: Hades
videos.overview: A brutal raid presses Cora to infiltrate the Los Angeles Police Department to retrieve a confiscated item that exposes a buried truth.

videos.title: Birther of Worlds
videos.overview: Battling to cover up their own secrets, Cora and Olwen partner to hunt a rogue colleague.

videos.title: Ho, Ho, Folks
videos.overview: Cora risks exposure when her past deceit lands her brother in danger. Olwen's missteps force her to retrace her past with a missing Replicant.

videos.title: Memory, Hither Come
videos.overview: Cora and Olwen track runaways to a Mexico City hideout. As dark ambitions clash with hidden secrets, both women confront painful pasts.

videos.title: My Lord
videos.overview: Cora investigates her past while Olwen faces new threats, forcing a dangerous reckoning.

videos.title: Kill the Killers
videos.overview: Cora and Olwen forge an uneasy alliance to hunt a lost relic. On Cora's home turf, old ghosts and new dangers close in. Hunted themselves, they must choose: compete or survive together.

videos.title: One More Kiss, Dear
videos.overview: Out of time and out of options, Olwen turns to Cora. Their uneasy alliance is tested when the past catches up to their doorstep.

videos.title: Share the Fantasy
videos.overview: Olwen's final hours meet Cora's desperate bid for legacy. When ambitions collide, no one escapes unchanged.
